theorems.statement: ∀ (n m k : ℕ) (G : Rn n → (Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k)) (z : Rn n) (T : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k) (A R α s₀ : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < α → 0 < s₀ → Measurable G → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (volume (closedBall z t))⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x in closedBall z t, ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (G x - G z))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall z (s / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (G x - T)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (A * s ^ n * (s / R) ^ (2 * α))) → G z = T
